# Map pipeline output (generated by `npm run map` in scripts/tableslop)

Run from repo:

```bash
cd scripts/tableslop
npm install   # once
npm run map
```

Then open:

- `output/contact-sheet.jpg` — all panels at a glance
- `output/thumb.jpg` — full stitched preview
- `output/master-enhanced.png` — final master
- `panels/enhanced/` — each upscaled panel individually

See `../README-map-pipeline.md` for options.
